stemMd: A map has scale 1:25,000. Two points are 6 cm apart on the map. What distance does this represent?
explanationMd: Multiply the map length by the scale factor: 6 × 25,000 = 150,000 cm. Since 100,000 cm equals 1 km, the real distance is 1.5 km. Keep units visible through the conversion.

distractorRationale.d: This is ten times too small after converting centimetres to metres.
distractorRationale.c: This is ten times too large.
distractorRationale.e: This divides by the scale instead of multiplying.
distractorRationale.a: This fails to convert centimetres to kilometres correctly.
